title: When coincidences line up
header_line: My analysis of one book on negotiation. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What events are lining up with your direction right now?
A student said that events appear that are aligned with your greater goal, synchronized with the direction you are going, and that he often talks about it with me as an entrepreneur.
Another said that while dealing with a cost-of-acquisition problem, a new kind of inspection work fell into their lap and solved every problem they had.
I said that the key is that your awareness has to get to the point where, getting into a ride, you are aware there is chemistry there, and a coincidence becomes an accident of essence.
I recalled a conversation about bringing a tourist who pays for the tour, and that it is also access to a client who can buy real estate, and said it came out of that conversation.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write the events lining up with your goal.
Write the one you almost missed.
Write the conversation that led to it.

check.q: What did a student say about events?
choices: They are aligned with your greater goal

recap: Notice when events line up. Be aware enough to act.
